title: Seen and Not Heard
tagline: Children are seen and not heard.
description:
Keeps children out of SkyrimNet conversations. Every child race in the load order is added to the actor filter's blacklist, so children never speak, think aloud or write diary entries, whichever filter mode you use.

There is one file per mod that adds a child race (the vanilla races, RS Children, Fertility Mode, Legacy of the Dragonborn and The Wheels of Lull), plus two for creatures that borrow the child flag for their size (Dwarfsphere's Snippy and Wind Path's hares). Each can be switched back on from the Filters page on its own.
author: min
